Hi — gentle reminder to finish up the scorecards. A few process details to keep consistent:

Rubric reminders (please paste a 1-sentence rationale into the comment box):
- Technical correctness (1-5) — did candidate reason through trade-offs?
- System design (1-5) — architecture clarity + constraints handling
- Ownership & cross-team communication (1-5)
- Execution (1-5) — past delivery examples

If you left a marginal 3 on System Design, please add a sentence: which assumption changed your score and why. This avoids extra back-and-forth.

Clock: if both scores are within 0.5 across all competencies, we'll run a 30-min tie-break. Ben, you've indicated Mon 11am and Marissa, you offered Tue/Wed — I propose Tue 9:30-10:00 PT as the tie-break (see attached tiebreak-ics.ics). If that doesn't work, I'll set up a short async call (Slack thread + written pros/cons) and lock a resolution by EOD Tue.

Greenhouse link to candidate record: https://greenhouse.io/boards/redwood/candidates/amit-verma-4532
